name: All-Con
blurb: Dallas hotel convention mixing sci-fi, cosplay, gaming and tabletop fandom with a themed dance party every night.
notes: All-Con's Year 22 edition (March 12-15, 2026) already concluded before this research window, and neither the homepage nor the hotel page names a Year 23 / 2027 date yet (both still display the Year 22 banner and its room-block rates). Venue is the Hilton Dallas Lincoln Centre by the Galleria: the site itself only gives the street address '5410 Lyndon B Johnson Freeway, Dallas, TX 75240', confirmed to that hotel via a web search. Cover picked from the homepage's 'menu/2026.png' year-badge graphic since no larger key art or logo is on the page; the other homepage images are either small guest headshots from the concluded edition or generic layout art.
